_comment: Grow's worlds, in home order. `live` false = shown as coming. `kind` picks the screen (GrowPanel.jsx SCREENS): `lessons` = LessonWorld fed by its hook (lib/useWordsWorld.js, lib/useHadithWorld.js, lib/useQuranWorld.js), `book` = BookWorld (a book's parts, then a part's lessons) from `source` (lib/useBookWorld.js), answers filed under `module`. `backdrop` (optional) names a picture in public/grow/backdrops/manifest.json to fade in behind the world's screen (components/grow/Backdrop.jsx); lib/backdrops.test.js checks it exists. `view` (lessons) picks the world's picture, components/grow/scenes; without one the world page lists its stages. Colour: theme.json `world` by id.
_lesson: A lessons world's numbers: `new` new items, up to `most-new` when little is due, `size` items in all (the rest due reviews). `stages`: items learnt (server 'known') to finish each stage. `unit`: what the items are called. `surahs` (Quran): the surahs the items come from, in order.

worlds.name: Words
worlds.idea: Every word you learn is a seed planted.

worlds.name: Fiqh
worlds.idea: Purity, prayer and more, chapter by chapter: what is fard, what is sunnah, and why.

worlds.name: Quran
worlds.idea: Each ayah you fill in lights a star.

worlds.name: Hadith
worlds.idea: An-Nawawi's Forty, one hadith at a time.

worlds.name: Sarf
worlds.idea: How Arabic builds its verbs and nouns, bab by bab: the sound verb, then each weak kind.

worlds.name: Nahw
worlds.idea: The first book of grammar: words, endings, and what raises, sets and pulls a noun.
